mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,producer_invocation,upload_id,production_fence,state,snapshot_key,sha256,size,media_type,created_at,updated_at,expires_at,record_version,file_receipt,receipt_digest FROM artifact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task}
SELECT id FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND state='SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY ordinal DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held+#{size} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
UPDATE artifact SET state='VERIFIED',snapshot_key=#{key},production_fence=#{fence},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{artifact} AND task_id=#{task} AND state='STAGING'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,producer_invocation,upload_id,production_fence,state,snapshot_key,sha256,size,media_type,created_at,updated_at,expires_at,record_version,file_receipt,receipt_digest FROM artifact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{artifact} AND task_id=#{task}
mapper.update: UPDATE artifact SET state='PUBLISHED',production_fence=#{fence},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{artifact}
UPDATE reservation SET state='SETTLED',actual=amount WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{artifact}
mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.id,a.task_id,a.producer_invocation,a.upload_id,a.production_fence,a.state,a.snapshot_key,a.sha256,a.size,a.media_type,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.expires_at,a.record_version,a.file_receipt,a.receipt_digest FROM artifact a JOIN task t ON a.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND a.task_id=t.id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.id=#{artifactId} AND t.owner_actor_id=#{actor} AND a.state IN ('PUBLISHED','EXPIRED')

SELECT a.id FROM artifact a JOIN invocation i ON i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND i.id=a.producer_invocation AND i.task_id=a.task_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.task_id=#{taskId} AND a.state='PUBLISHED' AND a.file_receipt IS NOT NULL AND i.tool='present' AND i.state='SUCCEEDED'
SELECT id FROM artifact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state<>'PUBLISHED'
